statement.zh: 聚落考古与教科文表述将蒙特·阿尔班定为瓦哈卡谷地古代萨波特克都城（Blanton 1978；UNESCO 415）。
statement.en: Settlement archaeology and UNESCO frame Monte Albán as the ancient Zapotec capital of the Valley of Oaxaca (Blanton 1978; UNESCO 415).
